title: Pioneer Periodicity Explorer: reconstruction and AI-assisted reassessment of a 1998 Pioneer 10/11 analysis
description: Local-first Python software used to reproduce the principal 1998 Pioneer 10/11 energetic-particle ACF/CCF benchmarks and to run the subsequent calendar-aware, sampling-window, surrogate, and intermittent robustness analyses documented in the accompanying technical report. The modern signal-analysis component is AI-assisted and has not undergone independent specialist validation.
